description: The Bosch Series 8 Built-in Warming Drawer (BIC7101B1) is a sleek and sophisticated addition to any modern kitchen. Measuring 60 x 14 cm and finished in an elegant black, this warming drawer integrates seamlessly into your kitchen cabinetry for a clean, flush appearance. The convenient Push-Pull opening mechanism ensures effortless access, while the Soft Close design adds a premium touch to every use. Designed for versatility, it offers dedicated Plate Warming and Food Warming functions, keeping your dishes and meals at the perfect serving temperature. The Defrost Function further adds to its practicality, making it a truly multi-purpose kitchen appliance. Operating at 230 volts, this built-in unit is engineered to deliver consistent performance. Whether you are entertaining guests or simply enjoying a family meal, the Bosch Series 8 Warming Drawer ensures your food and crockery are always ready at the right temperature. A must-have for those who value both style and functionality in their kitchen.
